messages:
emily_marketing: Quick sync — need final copy for launch posts (Twitter/LinkedIn), benchmark narrative for the blog, and the webinar landing page + inbound lead routing decisions. Goal: ship launch next Wed. Decisions by EOD Fri?
kevin_gm: Ok. For messaging we should split by persona: devs (Hosted API), platform (Dedicated), security/compliance (Private). Each needs a hero and a 2-line supporting blurb. :+1:
nisha_growth: For webinar flow: capture role + infra tier on the form, route leads to SDR queue 1 for platform/enterprise, SDR queue 2 for self-serve. Can we add checkbox for "interested in private deployment"? Also need CTAs: "Start free trial" vs "Contact sales".
liam_prod: Draft hero ideas:
- Hosted: "Build faster with predictable, low-latency inference"
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU capacity for production SLAs"
- Private: "Inference your way, on your network"
matt_design: I'll prepare 3 hero comps tomorrow. Need final short headlines and subheads.
emily_marketing: Love the drafts. Let's A/B test subtle tone differences: one focused on performance, one on economics. Also we need benchmark narrative: pick 2 representative workloads (chatbots w/8k context, embeddings at scale). We should show latency and cost-per-token comparisons vs public clouds. nisha_growth: I can get benchmarking numbers from eng-perf; will share a summary doc.
emily_marketing: Routing rules (draft):
```
if form.role in ["platform_engineer", "security"] => route -> enterprise-sdr
elif form.interested_private == true => route -> private-sales
else => route -> self-serve-nurture
```
Can ops/eng check compatibility with existing HubSpot fields?
kevin_gm: Sounds good. We should also map landing CTAs to UTM and cohort tags for analytics.
matt_design: note: hero comps will include CTA variants for each mode.
liam_prod: small tweak to Hosted hero: change "low-latency" -> "predictable latency" (more precise).
emily_marketing: Good. Action items:
- nisha: confirm routing + create HubSpot field mapping by Thu
- liam: finalize headline variants by Thu
- matt: hero comps by Fri AM
- kevin: define benchmark chart specs + target KPI callouts
I'll collate and run copy pass Mon. ping me if blocked. :rocket:
nisha_growth: on it. sharing Airtable with routing matrix: https://airtable.com/shr... :calendar:
kevin_gm: I'll pull perf thresholds and mock charts.
emily_marketing: Thanks team — short weekly check on Fri 10am. /cc @product-weekly
